author: joshualevi.ai
caption:
Comment “TURBO” and I’ll send you the free tool that makes whole videos from one topic.

MoneyPrinterTurbo is a free, open source video generator (MIT, 138,000+ stars). Type a topic and it writes the script, records a voice, adds captions and music, and edits it together.

What I measured on my Mac: one video in 1 minute 59, three in 3 minutes 42. One attempt failed when the free voice service timed out, the retry worked. $0 spent, with a local AI model through Ollama and the free Edge voice.

The catch: I used my own clips. Stock footage needs a free Pexels or Pixabay key. You also need a terminal, Python and uv. And it’s a first draft: restyle the captions and check the facts.
